US lifts Turkey sanctions, considers F-35 jet sale

US President Donald Trump announced the lifting of sanctions on Turkey and indicated a potential sale of F-35 fighter jets. This development follows Turkey's purchase of Russian S-400 air defense systems, which had previously led to its removal from the F-35 program. The move has drawn attention, with questions raised about Pakistan's reaction.
